summary: Adopt docs/authored-verbatim-placeholder-authoring-design-20260911.md rev 3: verbatim text by construction (placeholder tokens), one admission gate with a token/expanded/captured lifecycle, capture once per digest, one bounded repair loop, overload classified in the provider layer with bounded physical calls.
invariants: Slide HTML reaches a checkpoint only through admit_slide_html; the checkpoint writer refuses HTML without a matching admission receipt.
Rendered integrity (text, QID identity and uniqueness, capture binding, deck order) is asserted on the captured admission; only search-based binding is removed.
Placeholder tokens are recognized in text nodes only, expanded once, non-recursively, from a server-controlled id table; expanded HTML is re-checked against resource limits and policy.
Visibility failures publish flag-only only on slides already accepted by the terminal flag-only policy (authored.verbatim-flagged-publish@2 stands).
Physical provider calls stay reserved against the attempt ledger and the operation deadline; overload retries are bounded and recorded.
After authoring, exactly one repair loop produces HTML; every candidate is admitted through the same gate.
No new judge or verify-repair loop is added; existing predicates are centralized.
decisions: Token granularity: whole-block tokens; character-range tokens only if measurement 3.1 shows in-run emphasis is common.
Repair-loop model budget N defaults to 1; N=2 is compared in experiment (c).

Author attempt ordinals: the ledger is aligned to code (three ordinals per operation attempt, the third reserved for the last author attempt that replaces the separate rescue path); supersedes authored.provider-attempt-budget-per-operation-attempt@1 once recorded.
The text binder is removed after one passing token-mode series and no unfinished legacy job remains.
Rollout order: gate on current representation (shadow, then switch) -> parser normalization -> token mode (knob, default off) -> provider layer -> single repair loop (knob, default off).
forbidden: Per-path fixes: adding a check or retry to one producer instead of the gate.
Reviving Deck IR, source-native, SlideSpec, or Composer layout ownership.
Relaxing renderer policy content or verbatim integrity predicates.
